title: PR8421 Staging runtime artifact attestation decoupling

phases.objective: Decouple Staging runtime artifact identity attestation from Full Recovery certification while preserving exact-head, live-Staging, provider, database, credential, and Production mutation boundaries.

e2e_journeys.entrypoint: Evaluate the exact PR head across runtime artifact attestation, certification script surface, environment-impact closure, and governance registration.
e2e_journeys.terminal_outcome: The runtime artifact attestation is independently signed and exact-head bound, Staging live certification remains required, Full Recovery authority stays separate, and Production mutation remains forbidden.
steps: Verify the runtime artifact attestation contract binds exact source SHA, tree SHA, build-context digest, app image identity, Gateway policy/source/build/bundle, and hashed container identity.
Verify Staging Live Certification consumes the runtime artifact attestation rather than Full Recovery certification for app-image binding.
Verify the changed critical declaration and staging runtime artifact attestation script are registered exactly in Constitution.control_plane_paths and convergence.automation_control_paths.
Verify staging and production environment impact is explicitly reviewed and live Staging certification remains required.
Preserve fail-closed Full Recovery acquisition, canary, countersign, provider, database, credential, and Production mutation boundaries.
assertions: cross_environment_reviewed is true and live_staging_certification_required is true.
production_mutation_allowed is false and secrets_included is false.
The runtime artifact attestation signing domain remains separate from Activation Gateway ingress trust.
No provider mutation, database mutation, Production mutation, Recovery acquisition authority, synthetic OAuth evidence, or autonomous merge authority is introduced.
